types.name: Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601)
types.purpose: Tourism or business visitor activities for eligible passport holders, applied for in the Australian ETA app.
types.note: Up to 3 months after each entry. Study or training up to 3 months in total.

types.name: eVisitor (subclass 651)
types.purpose: Tourism or business visitor activities for EU and some other European passport holders. Free.
types.note: Up to 3 months after each entry.

types.name: Visitor (subclass 600)
types.purpose: Tourism, visiting family, business visitor activities or sponsored family visits, for any nationality.
types.note: Each grant allows a stay of 3, 6 or 12 months — the period on your grant letter is what counts.

types.name: Transit visa (subclass 771)
types.purpose: Passing through Australia, or joining a ship as crew.
types.note: No longer than 72 hours (5 days to sign on to a ship as crew).

types.name: Medical Treatment visa (subclass 602)
types.purpose: Medical treatment or consultations in Australia, or supporting someone who is.
types.note: Temporary; the stay is set on your grant.

types.name: Working Holiday visa (subclass 417)
types.purpose: Holiday and short-term work for 18–30 year olds (35 for some countries) from partner countries.
types.maxValidity: 12 months; a 2nd and 3rd year possible with specified work

types.name: Work and Holiday visa (subclass 462)
types.purpose: Holiday and short-term work for 18–30 year olds from partner countries (education and English requirements).
types.maxValidity: 12 months; a 2nd and 3rd year possible with specified work

types.name: Student visa (subclass 500)
types.purpose: Full-time study at a registered course.
types.maxValidity: Up to 6 years, in line with your enrolment

types.name: Student Guardian visa (subclass 590)
types.purpose: Guardians of student visa holders under 18.
types.maxValidity: Linked to the student visa holder

types.name: Training visa (subclass 407)
types.purpose: Workplace-based training or professional development.

types.name: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482)
types.purpose: Skilled work for an approved Australian employer that cannot find a local worker.

types.name: Temporary Work (Short Stay Specialist) visa (subclass 400)
types.purpose: Short-term, highly specialised, non-ongoing work.
types.note: Usually up to 3 months; longer needs a strong business case.

types.name: Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408)
types.purpose: Short-term work in specific activities: entertainment, sport, research, religious work, events, exchanges.
types.maxValidity: From 3 months to 4 years, depending on the activity

types.name: Temporary Work (International Relations) visa (subclass 403)
types.purpose: Work under government agreements: diplomats' private staff, Pacific Australia Labour Mobility, foreign government agencies.
types.maxValidity: Up to 4 years, depending on the stream

types.name: Crew Travel Authority (subclass 942)
types.purpose: International airline crew.
types.maxValidity: Until you stop working as airline crew
types.note: Crew members and safety inspectors up to 30 days at a time.

types.name: Maritime Crew visa (subclass 988)
types.purpose: Crew of non-military ships arriving in Australia.
types.note: You may stay as long as you are crew of an eligible ship that is in Australia.

types.name: Special Purpose visa
types.purpose: People with a prescribed status — e.g. military personnel, guests of government, some airline crew.
types.maxValidity: As long as you have the prescribed status

types.name: Special Category visa (subclass 444)
types.purpose: New Zealand citizens living and working in Australia; granted on arrival.
types.note: No day count while you stay.

types.name: New Zealand Citizen Family Relationship (temporary) visa (subclass 461)
types.purpose: Family members of New Zealand citizens living in Australia.

types.name: Partner visa — outside Australia (subclass 309/100)
types.purpose: Spouse or de facto partner of an Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible New Zealander, applying from outside Australia.
types.maxValidity: Temporary (309) until the permanent visa (100) is decided

types.name: Partner visa — in Australia (subclass 820/801)
types.purpose: Spouse or de facto partner of an Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible New Zealander, applying in Australia.
types.maxValidity: Temporary (820) until the permanent visa (801) is decided

types.name: Prospective Marriage visa (subclass 300)
types.purpose: Coming to Australia to marry your Australian partner, then apply for a partner visa.

types.name: Parent visa (subclass 103)
types.purpose: Parents of a settled Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible New Zealander.

types.name: Aged Parent visa (subclass 804)
types.purpose: Parents of pension age of a settled Australian, applying in Australia.

types.name: Contributory Parent visa (subclass 173/143)
types.purpose: Parents of a settled Australian, with a higher contribution and faster processing.

types.name: Contributory Aged Parent visa (subclass 884/864)
types.purpose: Parents of pension age of a settled Australian, applying in Australia, with a higher contribution.

types.name: Sponsored Parent (Temporary) visa (subclass 870)
types.purpose: Parents visiting their Australian children for longer periods.

types.name: Child visa (subclass 101/802)
types.purpose: Dependent children of an Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible New Zealander.

types.name: Dependent Child visa (subclass 445)
types.purpose: Dependent children of a partner visa holder.
types.maxValidity: Until the parent's permanent visa is decided

types.name: Adoption visa (subclass 102)
types.purpose: Children adopted, or being adopted, by Australian citizens or permanent residents.

types.name: Orphan Relative visa (subclass 117/837)
types.purpose: Children under 18 whose parents cannot care for them, sponsored by an Australian relative.

types.name: Remaining Relative visa (subclass 115/835)
types.purpose: People whose only close family are in Australia.

types.name: Aged Dependent Relative visa (subclass 114/838)
types.purpose: Older, single relatives financially dependent on an Australian relative.

types.name: Carer visa (subclass 116/836)
types.purpose: Caring for an Australian relative with a long-term medical condition.

types.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)
types.purpose: Invited skilled workers with an occupation on the skilled list, no sponsor needed.

types.name: Skilled Nominated visa (subclass 190)
types.purpose: Skilled workers nominated by a state or territory.

types.name: Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa (subclass 491)
types.purpose: Skilled workers living and working in regional Australia, nominated by a state or sponsored by family.

types.name: Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (provisional) visa (subclass 494)
types.purpose: Skilled workers sponsored by a regional employer.

types.name: Permanent Residence (Skilled Regional) visa (subclass 191)
types.purpose: Holders of a 491 or 494 visa who lived and worked in regional Australia.

types.name: Skilled Regional (provisional) visa (subclass 489)
types.purpose: Older regional skilled visa (closed to new applicants except some family members).

types.name: Skilled Regional visa (subclass 887)
types.purpose: Holders of certain provisional regional visas who lived and worked in regional Australia.

types.name: Employer Nomination Scheme (subclass 186)
types.purpose: Skilled workers nominated by an Australian employer.

types.name: Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme (subclass 187)
types.purpose: Skilled workers nominated by a regional employer (mostly closed to new applicants).

types.name: Pacific Engagement Visa (subclass 192)
types.purpose: Citizens of Pacific countries and Timor-Leste selected in the annual ballot.

types.name: National Innovation visa (subclass 858)
types.purpose: People with an internationally recognised record of exceptional achievement.

types.name: Distinguished Talent visa (subclass 124)
types.purpose: People with an internationally recognised record of exceptional achievement, applying from outside Australia.

types.name: Business Innovation and Investment (provisional) visa (subclass 188)
types.purpose: Business owners and investors (closed to new applicants).

types.name: Business Talent (Permanent) visa (subclass 132)
types.purpose: High-level business owners and entrepreneurs (closed to new applicants).

types.name: Refugee visas (subclass 200, 201, 203, 204)
types.purpose: People outside their home country who are subject to persecution.

types.name: Global Special Humanitarian (subclass 202)
types.purpose: People subject to substantial discrimination, proposed by someone in Australia.

types.name: Protection visa (subclass 866)
types.purpose: People in Australia who engage Australia's protection obligations.

types.name: Temporary Protection visa (subclass 785)
types.purpose: People who arrived without a valid visa and engage Australia's protection obligations.

types.name: Safe Haven Enterprise visa (subclass 790)
types.purpose: People who arrived without a valid visa, engage protection obligations and want to work or study in regional Australia.

types.name: Bridging visa A (subclass 010)
types.purpose: Staying lawfully in Australia while a new substantive visa application is processed.

types.name: Bridging visa B (subclass 020)
types.purpose: Travelling out of and back into Australia while a substantive visa application is processed.
types.maxValidity: Temporary; the travel period is set on the grant

types.name: Bridging visa C (subclass 030)
types.purpose: Staying lawfully while an application is processed, when you had no substantive visa.

types.name: Bridging visa E (subclass 050/051)
types.purpose: Staying lawfully while you arrange to leave, or while a matter is resolved.

types.name: Resident Return visa (subclass 155/157)
types.purpose: Permanent residents and former citizens travelling back to Australia as permanent residents.
types.note: No day count in Australia; it only governs re-entry.

types.name: Former Resident visa (subclass 151)
types.purpose: Former residents who spent their childhood in Australia or served in the Australian Defence Force.
